answer: Sybil partitions are contained by binding each agent identity to a distinct optical spectrum slot whose provenance is logged in a dynamic routing graph, so forged nodes cannot wander across the topology without a verifiable spectral handshake. Each peer gossips a signed sonnet of slot attestations, and any fable of fabricated identity collapses when the claimed spectrum. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
